card.name: Units after "up to" in storage limits
card.fires_on: The unit word or number ending a quantity limit, mostly "hours" after "stored for up to 24" and "mg" after a dose range. It also fires on "unlimited" or "any" in non-drug text.

modes.label: Storage time limits
modes.description: "hours" right after a number in "stored for up to 24 hours" phrases.
modes.example: Any unused mixture may be stored for up to 24<< hours>> in refrigerated conditions.

modes.label: Dose range end
modes.description: The unit "mg" or a number closing a dosage or timing range.
modes.example: The dosage range for rosuvastatin tablets is 5 mg to 40<< mg>> orally once daily.

modes.label: Unlimited or any
modes.description: Quantity words like "unlimited" or "any" in computer help text.
modes.example: there can be an<< unlimited>> number of ACEs per file

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting "any" next, as in "any" or "任何".
card.plain: It lights up on the unit at the end of a limit, like "24 hours" in how long a mixture can be stored.
